mechanism: Axe scans race the transient hint auto-hide opacity/transform fade. The three aggregate failures start during that fade after the hint theme background transition is complete. Earlier definite passing scans can resolve later incomplete scans, explaining the tagged passing aggregate despite raw incomplete measurements.

hypotheses.beforeCanvasPaint: refuted for the three aggregate failures: the actual prior compositor frames were visually inspected and show the rendered molecule
hypotheses.duringThemeColorTransition: not supported for these failures: hint background transition ended before each failing scan
hypotheses.duringHintAutoHideFade: observed in all eight raw incomplete scans across both Calculation themes

measurementLimit: Observers/CDP can perturb timing. No diagnostic frequency is a population flake rate; rAF alone is not proof of canvas presentation. Actual compositor images and original raw scans are retained.
